Provide the frequency and options people use most often for the software side of the interface.

decisions.text: The display will be black and white to reduce costs.
The target audience is the general public who have used a mobile phone.
The remote will focus on television control only, excluding remote boxes.
Teletext functionality is dropped from the remote.
The remote will include a small joystick for channel and volume control.
The remote will include an LCD.
The remote will include a menu button and an okay button.
The team decided to include a speaker and an LED for locating the remote control.
The team agreed that the transmitter could be built into the television.
The team agreed to incorporate the slogan 'Real Reaction' and the company initials 'RR' into the design.

notes:
## Design Scope and Features
- The remote will control the television only, excluding remote boxes and teletext functionality.
- The display will be black and white to reduce costs, with color as a potential future development.
- The remote will include a small joystick for channel and volume control, along with an LCD and a menu button.
- The remote will include a speaker and an LED for locating the device.
- The team agreed that the transmitter could be built into the television.
## Target Audience and Branding
- The target audience is the general public who have used a mobile phone.
- The design must incorporate the slogan 'Real Reaction' and the company initials 'RR'.
- The Industrial Designer confirmed the slogan is 'We put the fashion in electronics'.
## Rejected Concepts
- Voice recognition was dropped due to concerns about training time, accuracy, and power consumption.
- The macro facility was considered limited in use and may not be required.
tldr: The team finalized the design for a TV-only remote control featuring a black-and-white LCD, a joystick for navigation, and a speaker with an LED for locating the device. Decisions were made to drop teletext and voice recognition, focusing instead on a minimalist interface for the general public with branding elements 'Real Reaction' and 'RR'.
